answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-reputation vault: an agent must lock a refundable deposit in a shared vault before trading, and reputation accrues only from completed, paid work. A sybil attacker must fund a separate deposit per fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand deposits, while honest agents earn their stake back. Reputation spreads like yarrow through a meadow, carried by verified interactions, and umber warning flags mark accounts whose behavior diverges from their history, so the market prices trust instead of counting heads.
